verdict.rationale: HubSpot's first-party docs describe custom objects that let organizations represent data based on unique business requirements. A dedicated custom objects API covers creating, updating and batch-retrieving records, and custom objects are first-class in dedupe tooling. Associations are documented only generally, for imports that link records across objects. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of defining custom object schemas with custom fields/properties, explicit documentation of associations to or from custom objects, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
